allow.heading: Luigi's Woodfired Pizza
allow.reason: Sample-data restaurant name from the design mock's merchant list. The /restaurants page implements the full restaurant-card section (thumbnail, favorite toggle, Currently Closed overlay, rating + review count, cuisine/price line, delivery fee) fed by GET /api/restaurants; rows render the seeded catalog (Bella Italia is the equivalent wood-fired Italian pizzeria at 4.7), never a hardcoded design name.
